name: plugin.differential_facet_verifier
description: Multi-provider differential facet comparison, absence claimability gates, and 3-valued differential outcome synthesis from REA (morluto/rea).

entrypoints.name: facet_compare
entrypoints.description: Compare two multi-provider observation dossiers and emit a 3-valued DifferentialReport.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: Left observation record with facet availability

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: Right observation record with facet availability

parameters.name: providers_differ
parameters.description: Whether observations come from differing providers

entrypoints.name: facet_claim_absence
entrypoints.description: Evaluate whether an absence claim is valid under declared traversal coverage.

parameters.name: coverage
parameters.description: Coverage declaration object with status, truncated, and omitted_count
